comments.author: @LorettaClifton-y3f
comments.text: It took me a few years for my husband to convince me to holiday in England his Birth Place nearly 30 years ago. I guess it was because I imagined England being like Coronation Street. What a surprise when I got there. Nothing like I expected ,in fact I was blown away by its beauty Every County was so different and each little village had its own uniqueness that I couldn’t get enough You could spend a Lifetime travelling in England and not see it all We spent 5 months based in Lancaster then we took weekly trips to visit places we wanted to see and weekend trips to visit nearer areas. Bath ,York, Canterbury and Chester were my favourite places but really, England is full of Beauty and Charm. I loved the  people too
